hint_ladder.title: Alamin ang bawat square
hint_ladder.text: I-compute mo muna: 5^2 = 5 x 5 = 25; 3^2 = 3 x 3 = 9. 'Wag laktawan.

hint_ladder.title: Itugma sa choices
hint_ladder.text: Ang 16 ay option C. 'Yan ang tamang sagot.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you subtracted first (5-3=2) and squared it to get 4. Remember, exponents come before subtraction.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you subtracted 5-3=2, then multiplied by 4 (maybe thinking (5-3)×4) to get 8, skipping proper squaring.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you only squared 5 (25) then subtracted plain 3, giving 22. 'Wag kalimutang i-square din ang 3.

next_time_rule: Tandaan: unahin ang exponents bago mag-minus. 5^2 - 3^2 ≠ (5-3)^2.
deconstruct_text:
Sa project ni Barangay, bumili si Kap ng 5 boxes na may 5 reams ng bond paper bawat isa. That's 5^2 = 25 reams. Ginamit ang 3 boxes na may 3 reams each (3^2 = 9 reams). So natira: 25 - 9 = 16 reams. Same sa math: compute exponents muna, 5^2 - 3^2 = 25 - 9 = 16.

Mental Trick (Taglish): Isipin mo 'yong exponent parang pagsasakay ng jeep: 5 sakay ng 5, 3 sakay ng 3. Bawas lang nang diretso, 'wag mo munang paghalu-haluin ang sakay bago i-minus, kundi mapapamura ka sa (5-3)^2 na sagot. 'Sakay muna bago baba!'
